sloka: ततः स सुमहाप्राज्ञः हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।जगाम आदाय तौ वीरौ हरि राजाय राघवौ ॥४-४-३३॥
transliteration: tataḥ sa sumahāprājñaḥ hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।jagāma ādāya tau vīrau hari rājāya rāghavau ॥4-4-33॥

translations.english: Hanuman, son of the Windgod, endowed with great wisdom carried both the Raghava warriors to the king of monkeys.
